items.title: Repository scaffold, developer toolchain, CI and local services
items.outcome: An unassisted developer can clone, bootstrap and test a modular-monolith project on supported Ubuntu without a cloud account or real model subscription.

items.title: Goal contracts, tasks, attempts and database migration v1
items.outcome: A goal is represented by an immutable, structured, validated contract, with a persisted task DAG and attempt history supporting optimistic concurrency and executable acceptance criteria.

items.title: DBOS-backed durable single-task execution and recovery
items.outcome: An accepted synthetic goal runs through a DBOS workflow and recovers after sudden process death while preserving authoritative task state and auditable events.

items.title: Synthetic worker, isolated Git workspace and deterministic verification
items.outcome: A single mock worker edits only synthetic test files, emits normalized events, and generates immutable diff/test evidence verified without model judgment.

items.title: Minimal goal/approval API and CLI end-to-end synthetic slice
items.outcome: A user can submit a synthetic goal, observe authoritative progress, review exact evidence, approve or deny a bound action, and recover across server restart.

items.title: Lease fencing, retry bounds, outbox and external-action reconciliation
items.outcome: A lost or stale worker cannot publish results, and ambiguous remote effects are reconciled instead of blindly retried.

items.title: Independent project trust, data privacy and autonomy policy model
items.outcome: Effective authority is the intersection of three independently versioned policy axes, with a denied axis always taking precedence.

items.title: Sandbox profiles, mount validation and enforceable outbound controls
items.outcome: Worker filesystem, process, resource and network access are constrained at OS boundaries before any real repository or vendor account is used.

items.title: Loopback API authentication, host/origin hardening and approvals
items.outcome: Even local browser pages or untrusted network content cannot submit AgentOS actions, invoke approvals or hijack a localhost API.

items.title: Hardened Claude Code worker adapter and hostile-repository tests
items.outcome: One official Claude Code worker can perform a bounded, authorized code task without executing hostile repository-provided hooks, MCP servers, or plugin initialization.

items.title: Source-linked personal memory schema and five-stage use events
items.outcome: Offline Ask can retrieve owner/project-scoped memory with provenance, while every retrieval stage creates audit-ready data for later measurable personalization.

items.title: Routing outcomes, corrections and cloud-exposure event contracts
items.outcome: Every future routing/personalization decision has minimally sufficient evidence from the earliest real tasks, without claiming unavailable cost/quota data.

items.title: Research source snapshots, hashes, passage spans and claim evidence
items.outcome: A research claim is traceable to an actual retained and fetched source, with exact text offset and source content hash, not just a URL in generated prose.

items.title: OpenTelemetry correlation, canonical event replay and SSE
items.outcome: Trace and UI streams explain every decision without becoming the source of task truth; disconnected clients can replay missed events reliably.

items.title: Hardware probe integration and versioned capability manifest
items.outcome: AgentOS accurately measures installed CPU/GPU/RAM/disk/power and chooses feasible local model candidates without treating simulated specs as real.

items.title: Local inference adapter and warm/cold/pressure benchmarking
items.outcome: A user can invoke an offline steward locally, measure response speed and memory use on the actual GPU, and fail conservatively when inference is unavailable.

items.title: Offline Ask and source-scoped memory interaction
items.outcome: A user can quickly ask the primary local AI offline and retrieve previously approved project memory without leaking information across scopes.

items.title: Offline, degraded-mode and foreground-resource safety tests
items.outcome: Offline Ask remains useful without cloud/network, while CPU/GPU pressure does not cause resource starvation or corrupt task state.

items.title: Search abstraction and SSRF-safe web retrieval broker
items.outcome: AgentOS can search approved public web sources and fetch URLs without resolving or redirecting into internal endpoints, exposing secrets, or mixing reader and actor privileges.

items.title: Quarantined web reader and immutable source provenance
items.outcome: Every Delegate result is grounded in immutable fetched source snapshots processed by a sandboxed reader that has no privileged outbound-action tools.

items.title: Deterministic source citation and exact quotation verifier
items.outcome: A research brief cannot mark a factual claim evidenced unless every cited source actually exists and quoted passages exactly match the retained source text under documented normalization.

items.title: Claim-support adjudication, contradiction and uncertainty labeling
items.outcome: A separately validated verifier distinguishes source presence from actual evidential support, flags conflicts, and refuses false certainty.

items.title: Bounded Delegate planner, research brief output and R2 gate
items.outcome: A user can delegate a specific public-web research brief, inspect evidence and limitations, and obtain deterministic security guarantees around source retrieval.

items.title: Codex supported CLI adapter and contract suite
items.outcome: A second approved vendor harness can perform bounded work under exactly the same AgentOS worker contract and sandbox permissions as the first.

items.title: Build task DAG and bounded LangGraph reasoning/replan
items.outcome: A user intent is converted into an executable acyclic work plan with dependencies, acceptance checks and conservative bounded replanning.

items.title: Concurrent two-worker scheduler, worktree conflict control and admission
items.outcome: Two authorized workers execute independent plan steps concurrently without overwriting each other or exceeding CPU/GPU/provider/budget limits.

items.title: Single-worker verification and protected merge approval
items.outcome: One worker candidate is independently verified and can merge only with an exact scoped effect_digest-bound approval.

items.title: Integrated multi-worker verification and protected merge
items.outcome: Concurrent worker results are integrated, re-verified on the final tree and merged only with fresh exact approval.

items.title: React Mission Control task views, approvals and event replay
items.outcome: A locally served dashboard shows Ask, Delegate and Build intake, real task state, source evidence, worker fleet and exact pending approvals without creating a second state machine.

items.title: OTel/Phoenix tracing, cost/usage confidence and exposure dashboard
items.outcome: A user can trace every relevant model/tool decision and inspect what data was authorized or accessible to cloud workers versus observed network traffic, without leaking secrets.

items.title: A-1/D-1/B-1 acceptance, chaos and two-week dogfood gate
items.outcome: AgentOS proves three independent end-user workflows and its security/recovery invariants over a recorded two-week trial before claiming complete initial MVP.

items.title: Provider subscription entitlement telemetry and consented quota-aware routing
items.outcome: An eligible route is selected with explicit user consent and observed quota confidence, never by assuming an AI subscription can supply arbitrary backend tokens.

items.title: Controlled inference engine comparison: Ollama, vLLM and SGLang
items.outcome: Local runtime selection is based on measured task quality, throughput, latency, power and memory—not universal claims that one inference engine is always faster.

items.title: Adaptive quota/resource governor and optional secure API gateway
items.outcome: AgentOS continuously admits jobs under real CPU/GPU and provider constraints, selects economically justified eligible routes and protects foreground computing.

items.title: Provenance-aware context compiler, hybrid RAG, voice and quick desktop UX
items.outcome: AgentOS becomes a genuinely useful daily personal assistant: context follows tasks across agents, memory stays provenance-aware, and opt-in voice/desktop capture is governed by privacy controls.

items.title: Sandboxed computer use and authorized desktop/browser integrations
items.outcome: AgentOS can operate authorized desktop and browser tools under scoped identity, action approvals, and observability without granting raw screen content unfettered agent authority.

items.title: Offline evaluation, gated improvement, skill registry and memory lifecycle
items.outcome: AgentOS measurably improves task outcomes through approved, reversible candidate changes while detecting unsafe or non-causal personalization and memory deletion.

items.title: Portable open-source release, multi-machine evaluation and sustained operations
items.outcome: Users can install AgentOS on supported hardware, migrate safely, enforce privacy offline, recover tasks across restarts and maintain versioned plugins as an auditable open-source project.
